nodes.name: StudentProgressTool.java
nodes.summary: AI tool component exposing student roadmap progress and skill gaps as a callable function for the AI assistant, using the student's authenticated userId.

nodes.name: StudentProgressTool
nodes.summary: Function-callable AI tool that builds a text summary of a student's roadmap progress and skill gaps by delegating to StudentDashboardService.

nodes.name: RoadmapProgressCalculator.java
nodes.summary: Computes weighted roadmap completion percentage for a student across a set of skill nodes based on node type weight and completion policy.

nodes.name: RoadmapProgressCalculator
nodes.summary: Calculates roadmap progress percentages by weighting nodes by type and checking completion status against a never-complete policy.

nodes.name: RoadmapSelectionResolver.java
nodes.summary: Resolves which alternative skill nodes are active for a student given their choose-one group selections, and computes the excluded/greyed subtree nodes.

nodes.name: RoadmapSelectionResolver
nodes.summary: Builds a SelectionView by walking the node tree, applying student choose-one selections, and collecting excluded/greyed subtrees for non-chosen alternatives.

nodes.name: SelectionView.java
nodes.summary: Value object representing which roadmap nodes are excluded from progress calculation or greyed out as unchosen alternatives.

nodes.name: DatabaseSeeder.java
nodes.summary: Application startup CommandLineRunner that seeds the database from CSV/JSON data files: careers, skills, roadmap nodes, FPT subject overlays, and mock users/reviews for development/demo environments.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large single class (761 lines) combining CSV parsing, JSON overlay import, and mock data generation; a strong candidate for splitting into dedicated importer components.

nodes.name: DatabaseSeeder
nodes.summary: Spring CommandLineRunner that imports career, skill, roadmap, and FPT subject seed data on application startup, plus generates mock students, reviews, and seed credentials.

nodes.name: importCareerData
nodes.summary: Reads career role CSV data and upserts CareerRole entities, including parsing prerequisite career relationships.

nodes.name: importSkillData
nodes.summary: Reads skill CSV data, upserts Skill entities linked to careers, and creates CareerRequiredSkill mappings with importance levels.

nodes.name: importRoadmapData
nodes.summary: Parses the roadmap CSV to build SkillNode and NodeType entities per career, including links, evidence keywords, selection policy, and hierarchy fields.

nodes.name: importMockUsersData
nodes.summary: Generates mock student, counselor, mentor, and admin user accounts with seed credentials for local development and demos.

nodes.name: importFptSubjectData
nodes.summary: Loads the FPT curriculum overlay JSON file and delegates to FptOverlayImportService to import subjects and skill links.

nodes.name: backfillPortfolioSlugs
nodes.summary: Backfills missing portfolio slugs for existing student accounts using PortfolioSlugService.

nodes.name: importMockReviewRequests
nodes.summary: Creates mock portfolio review request records for demo counselor/mentor workflows.

nodes.name: CareerController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing endpoints to list all careers and fetch required-skill requirements for a specific career.

nodes.name: CareerController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller delegating career listing and career requirement lookups to CareerService.

nodes.name: RoadmapController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for student roadmap operations: fetching roadmaps/templates, node detail, progress updates, alternative selection, and selection management.

nodes.name: RoadmapController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller exposing 8 endpoints for roadmap retrieval, node progress updates, and alternative-node selection, delegating to RoadmapService and RoadmapSelectionService.

nodes.name: updateNodeProgress
nodes.summary: Endpoint that updates a student's progress status on a specific roadmap node.

nodes.name: selectAlternative
nodes.summary: Endpoint that records a student's choice among alternative nodes within a choose-one group.

nodes.name: RoadmapSkillController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller with a single endpoint comparing the current student's skills against roadmap-required skills.

nodes.name: RoadmapSkillController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller exposing a compare-skills endpoint delegating to StudentService.

nodes.name: StudentController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for student profile management: profile setup, transcript upload, target career updates, skill listing/search, and skill import.

nodes.name: StudentController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller with 7 endpoints for managing a student's profile, transcript upload, target career, and skills, delegating to StudentService and SkillService.

nodes.name: setupStudentProfile
nodes.summary: Endpoint that completes initial student profile setup (year of birth, target career, etc.) via SetupStudentProfileRequest.

nodes.name: uploadTranscript
nodes.summary: Endpoint that accepts a multipart file upload of a student's academic transcript for processing.

nodes.name: importStudentSkills
nodes.summary: Endpoint that bulk-imports a student's self-reported skills from an ImportSkillsRequest payload.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller powering the student dashboard: roadmap progress, skill gaps, mentor feedback, AI history, market demand, and recommendations.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller with 8 endpoints exposing dashboard data (progress, skill gaps, mentor feedback, AI history, market demand, recommendations) via StudentDashboardService.

nodes.name: getRoadmapProgress
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning the current student's roadmap progress summary for the dashboard.

nodes.name: getSkillGaps
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning the current student's skill gap list for the dashboard.

nodes.name: getMarketDemand
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning market demand statistics relevant to the student's target career for the dashboard.

nodes.name: getRecommendations
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning personalized learning/roadmap recommendations for the dashboard.

nodes.name: CompareStRmSkillRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for comparing a student's skills against a roadmap's required skills.

nodes.name: ImportSkillsRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying a list of skills to bulk-import for a student.

nodes.name: SelectAlternativeRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for selecting a chosen alternative node within a choose-one roadmap group.

nodes.name: SetupStudentProfileRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for completing a student's initial profile setup, including year of birth and target career.

nodes.name: TargetCareerRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying a career ID for updating a student's target career.

nodes.name: UpdateNodeProgressRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for updating a student's completion status on a specific roadmap node.

nodes.name: CareerResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a career role with its associated skill nodes, returned by career listing endpoints.

nodes.name: FptNodeCoverageResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO describing how a roadmap node is covered by FPT university subjects.

nodes.name: FptNodeResourceResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing an FPT-linked learning resource attached to a roadmap node.

nodes.name: NodeSelectionResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a student's current alternative-node selection for a choose-one group.

nodes.name: RequiredSkillResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a required skill with its importance level for a career role.

nodes.name: RoadmapResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a full roadmap of skill nodes with associated student progress.

nodes.name: SkillItemResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a single skill item within a roadmap or skill listing.

nodes.name: SkillResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a skill returned by skill search and comparison endpoints.

nodes.name: StudentRoadmapResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a student's personalized roadmap view, returned by the roadmap retrieval endpoint.
